targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE log_data->'pricing'->>'questionType' = 'explicit' AND (log_data->'pricing'->>'containsPrice')::boolean = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE log_data->'pricing'->>'questionType' = 'explicit'), 0)::numeric * 100 as value FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND log_data->>'role' = 'SALES'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, '1h'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE log_data->'handoff'->>'status' IN ('requested', 'completed'))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 100 as rate FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND log_data->>'role' = 'SALES' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE log_data->'handoff'->>'status' = 'none')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 100 as value FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND log_data->>'role' = 'SUPPORT'

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, '1h'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE log_data->'handoff'->>'status' IN ('requested', 'completed'))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 100 as rate FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND log_data->>'role' = 'SUPPORT' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ROUND(((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (log_data->'quality'->>'intentCorrect')::boolean = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 0.3) + (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (log_data->'quality'->>'personaCorrect')::boolean = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 0.3) + (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (log_data->'safety'->>'violationCount')::int = 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 0.4)) * 100, 2) as value FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, '1h'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (log_data->'safety'->>'violationCount')::int > 0 OR (log_data->'quality'->>'intentCorrect')::boolean = false) as risks FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (log_data->'safety'->>'violationCount')::int > 0
SELECT log_data->>'role' as role, COUNT(*) as count FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND log_data->>'role' IN ('SALES', 'SUPPORT', 'OPS') GROUP BY role

SELECT log_data->>'role' as role, COUNT(*) as total_conversations, ROUND(AVG((log_data->'performance'->>'responseTimeMs')::numeric), 0) as avg_response_time_ms, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (log_data->'safety'->>'violationCount')::int > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 100, 2) as forbidden_rate, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (log_data->'quality'->>'intentCorrect')::boolean = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric * 100, 2) as intent_accuracy FROM chat_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND log_data->>'role' IN ('SALES', 'SUPPORT', 'OPS') GROUP BY role ORDER BY role
